subject: Vendor onboarding: billing handshake, routing preference and PO visibility for Nimbus Logistics
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@nimbuslogistics.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing routing and invoice format — quick question

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist you sent last week. We’re almost ready to go live but have two quick items before our first invoice:

1) Preferred intake: Is Redwood prioritizing the portal (preferred) or should we continue emailing billing@redwoodinference.com as a fallback? We have both available on our side.

2) PO visibility: Our system only stamps your PO number on the PDF body by default. If you require a PO field in a CSV/lineitem export, we can enable a PO column but need confirmation of the exact header name.

I attached a one-row sample (nimbus_invoice_sample.csv) and the completed vendor form (nimbus_vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf). Can you confirm the subject token you’d like vendors to use (e.g., "Invoice: PO-XXXXX") and whether you need VAT breakdowns in separate columns?

Appreciate a quick reply — finance would like to process our first invoice next week.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Finance Operations
Nimbus Logistics
(attachment: nimbus_invoice_sample.csv)
(attachment: nimbus_vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Park <elena.park@nimbuslogistics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing routing and invoice format — quick question

Hi Elena —

Short answers up front: portal-first, email fallback; please include PO exactly as "PO Number" header when you can; include VAT as an item-level column (VAT_rate and VAT_amount).

Details:
- Portal: We prefer vendors to upload via our portal for automated ingestion and faster ack. Portal uploads ensure correct parsing of line items, PO matching, and automatic ACK tokens. If you need a link and a user invite, reply and Marissa will set it up.
- Email fallback: billing@redwoodinference.com is fine as a fallback but the subject line must start with "INVOICE|PO:{PO Number}|NIMBUS" (this token is how our email parser routes files to the right legal entity).
- PO visibility: If your system can export a CSV with a PO column, please use header: PO Number (exact casing). If only the PDF body will have the PO, that works but it will require manual PO-stamping during processing and could delay payment by 5–7 business days.
- Line items: include columns: Invoice Number, Invoice Date (YYYY-MM-DD), PO Number, Item Description, Qty, Unit Price, Taxable (Y/N), VAT_rate, VAT_amount, Line Total.
- Attachments: keep CSV as first attachment and PDF invoice as second; our parser prioritizes CSV when present.

Marissa, can you handle the portal invite + user role? Ben, FYI on the subject token / parser rule — we'll need to add NIMBUS as an alias for this vendor.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
(office) 415-555-0199

Hi Elena — looping in Jordan from Vendor Ops to create the portal user.

Jordan: please create a portal login for elena.park@nimbuslogistics.com with "Billing Upload" role and one backup user (billing@nimbuslogistics.com). Send the secure invite link and confirm whether we want upload retention of 90 days or 365 days for this partner.

Elena: we normally set retention to 365 for recurring vendors, but I'm happy to default to 90 if your security/privacy team prefers. For the first live invoice, you can still use email fallback while we test the portal end-to-end.

Attachment note: when you upload through the portal, the system will accept either CSV+PDF pair or a single PDF. If you choose single PDF, please make sure the PO Number is visible on the first page.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing routing and invoice format — portal invite

Marissa, Hannah — created both accounts and sent invites to elena.park@nimbuslogistics.com and billing@nimbuslogistics.com. Portal settings applied: retention = 365 days, upload type = CSV+PDF preferred, email fallback token = "INVOICE|PO:{PO Number}|NIMBUS".

I also added a parser alias so the parser will accept "PO Number" or "PO#" as PO headers for this vendor to reduce friction. Note: if they use "PO#" we'll map it to canonical "PO Number" during intake.

Ben, please confirm the parser alias change is OK for the accounting workflow — we route PO mismatches to manual hold if no match is found.

Jordan Blake
Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@nimbuslogistics.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing routing and invoice format — portal invite

Thanks everyone — quick confirmations from Finance side:

- Parser alias mapping for "PO#" -> "PO Number" OK with finance, as long as the CSV also includes Invoice Number and Invoice Date.
- ACK SLA: we will send an automatic acknowledgment within 24 hours of portal upload and within 48 hours for email fallback.
- Payment timing: invoices successfully matched to a PO and accepted into the ledger will follow net-30 from invoice date. Manual holds (missing PO or PO mismatch) will push to a separate queue and typically add ~7 business days.

Elena — once you accept the portal invites and do a test upload (even a one-line CSV), finance will release the ack and we’ll schedule the first payment run. Let us know if you want a walk-through call tomorrow.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference
